claims.text: TOR-TILD can be combined with machine-learning acceleration for a high-entropy material.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD can retain ab initio-level accuracy.
The proposed approach represents all thermodynamic effects important to the solid-to-fluid transition.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD improves determination of the transition temperature relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD improves determination of fusion enthalpy relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD improves determination of fusion entropy relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD improves determination of the volume change at the transition relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD improves determination of dense-fluid heat capacity relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
The proposed approach is applicable across relevant high-entropy compositions and temperatures.
Available data are insufficient for systematic screening of high-entropy materials.
